group: ray-finned fishes: Lake Tanganyika cichlid radiation (Ronco et al. 2021 Nature: 2,197 specimens, ~235 species on 05_BEAST_RAxML.tre; 21-LM body shape vs 27-LM lower pharyngeal jaw)

data.landmarks: Ronco F et al. 2021 Nature 589:76-81; Zenodo 3989859 (`06_landmark_data_body_shape.tps` 21 2D body landmarks across 2,197 specimens; `06_landmark_data_lower_pharyngeal_jaw.tps` 27 micro-CT lower pharyngeal jaw landmarks across 1,196 specimens).
data.phylogeny: Time-calibrated species tree `05_BEAST_RAxML.tre` (265 tips, ~9.7 Myr crown radiation).

what_thompson_specifically_adds: While the Rabosky test (`ronco2021_tanganyika_cichlids`) tested deep-horizon (>100 Myr) scalar ratio transfer from marine reef fish, re-training the 2D GM engine directly on Ronco's 235-species BEAST tree tests: (1) Thompson-7 variance share on an explosive freshwater adaptive radiation, (2) external hydrodynamic body shape (21 LMs) vs internal trophic Lower Pharyngeal Jaw (27 LMs) on the exact same species, and (3) within-radiation phylogenetic prediction.

hypotheses.statement: Across the ~235 Tanganyika cichlid species on `05_BEAST_RAxML.tre`, Thompson-7 captures > 55% of between-species Procrustes variance on the 21-LM body shape (matching the 57.9% marine reef-fish benchmark).
hypotheses.reasoning: Cichlid body-shape radiation (deep-bodied benthic grazers vs elongate pelagic piscivores) follows the same dorsoventral and caudal-peduncle modes as marine percomorphs.

hypotheses.statement: Leave-one-species-out phylogenetic prediction on `05_BEAST_RAxML.tre` strongly beats the grand consensus (median Procrustes RMS ratio < 0.65, paired one-sided Wilcoxon p < 1e-10) on 21-LM body shape.
hypotheses.reasoning: Dense sampling (~235 species across 12 Tanganyika tribes within a 10 Myr radiation) places most species within 1-3 Myr of a congeneric relative.

hypotheses.statement: Thompson-7 captures > 60% of the full-space phylogenetic prediction gain on 21-LM body shape AND beats the consensus on its own (Wilcoxon p < 1e-10).
hypotheses.reasoning: Tribe-level body-plan differences in Tanganyika cichlids are dominated by global elongation and depth modes.

hypotheses.statement: Internal trophic jaw vs external body: the 27-LM Lower Pharyngeal Jaw (2D dorsal XY projection) is also strongly predicted by phylogeny (LOO ratio vs consensus < 0.75, Wilcoxon p < 1e-10) and has > 50% Thompson-7 variance share.
hypotheses.reasoning: The cichlid lower pharyngeal jaw is a triangular/heart-shaped plate whose width-to-length ratio and posterior horn flare deform smoothly under Thompson's modes.
